priorityList: Interrupt with Disrupt and maintain Demon Spikes (off-GCD) as your primary defensive priority.
Cast Reaver's Glaive whenever the buff is available to begin the Aldrachi Reaver combat cycle.
When both Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs are active, prioritize Fracture to maximize AoE damage.
When only the Glaive Flurry buff is active, cast Spirit Bomb at 5 Fragments, otherwise cast Soul Cleave to consume the buff.
When only the Rending Strike buff is active, use Fracture to consume the buff and generate fragments.
Use Metamorphosis if Untethered Rage procs or whenever available to boost survivability and damage.
Apply Fiery Brand to a primary target, especially if Fiery Demise is talented, to initiate your high-damage window.
During Fiery Demise windows, prioritize Soul Carver and Sigil of Spite if you have 2 or fewer Fragments.
During Fiery Demise windows, cast Spirit Bomb when at 3+ Fragments and use Immolation Aura to extend fire damage.
Use Fel Devastation as long as you do not currently have Rending Strike or Glaive Flurry buffs active.
Cast Sigil of Spite and Soul Carver on cooldown when your Spirit Bomb/Fiery Demise window is ready or when low on Fragments.
Use Fracture as your primary generator whenever you have fewer than 3-5 Soul Fragments.
Spend Soul Fragments on Spirit Bomb in AoE situations once you reach your fragment cap (usually 4-5).
Maintain high uptime on Immolation Aura and use Sigil of Flame on cooldown for consistent AoE damage.
Use Felblade as a filler to generate Fury or bridge gaps in your rotation.
